sets.label: Abyssal Depths
sets.effect: Salvager get increased chance of finding Epic and Legendary animals.

sets.label: Arctic Tundra
sets.effect: Applies to: Public Moorings +100 Increased Visits: +5% Increases the chance of specialists visiting your island

sets.label: Cordillera
sets.effect: +10% increased workforce and income from Farmer and Jornalero Residence.

sets.label: Domestic Animals
sets.effect: Animal Farms have +5% production and -10% maintenance cost.

sets.label: Eastern Jungle
sets.effect: Harbor Activity +100%. Every time passive trade happens at the trading post, there is a chance of gaining 5t of Coffee Beans, Sugar Cane, Tobacco, Cotton, Cocoa, Plantains, Pearls, Chocolate, Coffee, Fried Plantains, Tortillas, or Sugar.

sets.label: Enbesan Highlands
sets.effect: Scholar Residence Consumption of Seafood Stew : -10% Consumption of Hibiscus Tea : -10%

sets.label: Extinct Species
sets.effect: +10% from Zoological Gardens. Inspiration: writers from all over your city will gather around your Zoological Gardens to offer you unique quests.

sets.label: Great Coral Reef
sets.effect: +2 Happiness and +2 (affects Worker Residence, Artisan Residence, Obrero Residence, and Hacienda Obrera Quarters).

sets.label: Great Desert
sets.effect: Applies to: Fire Station Extinguish Speed: +30% Unit Movement Speed: +10%

sets.label: Luminaries
sets.effect: +3 from Pubs, Variety Theatres, Members Clubs, Shopping Arcades and Restaurants (non-monument).

sets.label: Miombo Woodlands
sets.effect: Applies to: Lumberjack's Hut , Charcoal Kiln , Hunting Cabin Reduces the number of trees needed to reach optimal productivity by 10% Attractiveness : +5

sets.label: Ocean Predators
sets.effect: All Coastal Production Buildings receive +10% productivity, -10% maintenance cost, and require 5% less workforce.

sets.label: Polar Circle
sets.effect: All Cloth Industries have +25% production and -25% maintenance cost. (Applies to: Framework Knitters , Fur Dealer , Poncho Darner , Bombín Weaver , Tailor's Shop )

sets.label: Proud Savannah
sets.effect: Applies to: Cattle Farm , Alpaca Farm , Nandu Farm , All Powered Pastures Productivity: +25% No. of Modules: -25% Extra Goods: Occasionally produces extra output every 3rd cycle

sets.label: Rainforest
sets.effect: +30 from all Trade Unions.

sets.label: Snowflakes
sets.effect: -50% maintenance, +20% from Zoological Gardens

sets.label: Taiga Forest
sets.effect: Residents consume 5% less Fish, Bread, Canned Food, Sausages, Chocolate, Fried Plantains, Tortillas and Seafood Stew.

sets.label: Teeming Lakes
sets.effect: +20% Productivity for all Coastal Production Buildings

sets.label: Aegean Cultures
sets.effect: +5 and 20% reduced maintenance from Variety Theatres, Museums and Radio Towers. Variety Theatres have new tooltips displaying which play they are currently staging.

sets.label: Atlantean
sets.effect: Salvager get increased chance of finding Epic and Legendary artefacts.

sets.label: Battle of Trelawney
sets.effect: +20% increased damage to sailing ships Unwavering: your ship deals increased damage when its hitpoints are running low

sets.label: Bronze Age
sets.effect: Affects Lumberjacks' Huts, Hunting Cabins, Quarries and all Old and New World Orchards. +5% productivity, +5 and extra goods (extra output of the produced good: 1 extra ton per 10 cycles)

sets.label: Empire of the Eagle
sets.effect: +5% increased income from Residences. 10% reduced chance of fires, illness, riots and explosions from Residences.

sets.label: Gods of the Delta
sets.effect: +30 and +10 from Town Halls & Trade Unions

sets.label: Heirlooms of the Gold-Realm
sets.effect: Applies to: Trading Posts and Piers. Harbor Activity: 20%. Every time passive trade happens at the trading post, there is a chance of gaining 5t of Gold , Jewellery

sets.label: Icebound
sets.effect: Maintenance Cost: -20% affecting All Food Production, All Drinks Production Buildings, Chemical Plant: Lemonade, Orchard: Jam, Assembly Line: Biscuits, Artisan's Workshop: Cognac, and Chemical Plant: Chewing Gum.

sets.label: Jurassic
sets.effect: +10% income and +10 Happiness from Residences.

sets.label: Lost Cities
sets.effect: Harbour Activity +100%. Every time passive trade happens at the trading post, there is a chance of gaining 5t of Gold Ore, Gold or Jewellery

sets.label: Lost Tribes
sets.effect: Residences have -5% consumption of Sewing Machines , Canned Food and Coffee

sets.label: New World Huaca
sets.effect: Increased Visits: +5%. Increases the chance of specialists visiting your island. Special Guests: Unique specialists may visit your city.

sets.label: Northern Sagas
sets.effect: +5% maximum hitpoints and +3% increased damage for all of your warships

sets.label: Origin of Mankind
sets.effect: Increases productivity by 10% and -5% reduction in needed workforce and maintenance for all Fisheries, Crop Farms, Animal Farms, and Hunting Cabins

sets.label: Roots of Enbesa
sets.effect: Scholar Residences gain +1 research points

sets.label: Skull and Bones
sets.effect: +3% increased speed, -5% maintenance cost, and 10% damage slowdown for all warships

sets.label: Thule Relics
sets.effect: Thematic Exhibitions +20% Increased attractiveness for cultural items that belong to the Taiga forest, polar circle, arctic tundra, northern sagas, bronze age, thule relics, icebound, and sub-alpine cultural sets.

loose.n: Twenty-Thousand Days Around The Centre Of The Earth

sets.label: Amazonas
sets.effect: Old World: Grape fertility provided and +25% productivity for Vineyards · New World: Plantain Fertility provided and +25% productivity for Plantain Plantations

sets.label: Andean
sets.effect: Old World: Grain fertility provided and +25% productivity for Grain Farms · New World: Coffee fertility provided and +25% productivity for Coffee Plantations and Hacienda Coffee Farms

sets.label: Enchanted
sets.effect: Old World: Hops Fertility provided and +25% productivity for Hops Farms. · New World: Tobacco Fertility provided and +25% productivity for Tobacco Plantations.

sets.label: Marshland
sets.effect: Happiness +2, Chance of Illness -50% (affects all residences)

sets.label: Medicinal
sets.effect: Unit movement for hospitals +15% and +2 doctors

sets.label: Near East
sets.effect: Old World: Red Pepper Fertility provided and +25% productivity for Red Pepper Farms. · New World: Sugar Cane Fertility provided and +25% productivity for Sugar Cane Plantations and Hacienda Sugar Cane Farms.

sets.label: Sargasso Sea
sets.effect: Attractiveness of Public Mooring +50, Increased Visits +10%

sets.label: Sacred
sets.effect: Harbor activity +100%, Passive Trade chance for 5t of Coffee Beans, Cocoa, Plantains, Pearls, Felt, Bread, Grapes, or Chocolate

sets.label: Subalpine
sets.effect: Old World: Fur Abundance provided and +25% productivity for Hunting Cabins · New World: Caoutchouc fertility provided and +25% productivity for Caoutchouc Plantations and Hacienda Caoutchouc Plantations
